best: Every block is boxed under a descriptive title with a short explanatory note, and the power paths (3V3 buck, pack FET path, four-switch stage with input/output banks and sense resistors in line) read left to right like textbook drawings.
worst: Stacked GND pin numbers under U401 and U405 on the USB sheets overlap into an illegible clump
BQ25756 and the four-switch stage are tied only by HIDRV/LODRV/BTST/SW net labels, so the gate drive must be traced by name across the sheet
3V3 sheet leaves the lower half empty while the USB sheets are dense; MCU SWDIO/SWCLK/NRST are dangling local labels rather than wires to the debug header
